title: Oracle E-Business Suite exposes jtfwrepo.xml
summary: The repository file /OA_HTML/jtfwrepo.xml is served to anyone, with the text/xml content type and a body carrying a password field or a user list. It is an internal configuration file that can disclose credentials, and it should never be reachable from outside.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known and the exposed file is told apart from a soft 404.
confirm.differential: status == 200 and "text/xml" in header("content-type") and (body_contains("password=") or body_contains("<PUSR_LIST>")) and body_differs(control)

reproduce: curl -sk 'https://host/OA_HTML/jtfwrepo.xml' and check it returns HTTP 200 with a text/xml body that contains 'password=' or '<PUSR_LIST>'. That file is internal configuration and should not be reachable without authentication.
remediate: Block /OA_HTML/jtfwrepo.xml at the web tier and with the Oracle E-Business Suite Allowed Resources (URL Firewall) framework, so the repository file is not served to unauthenticated clients. Rotate any credential the file disclosed.
